    d."XCL_038" AS forename,
    d."XCL_039" AS surname,
    d."XCL_041" AS nationality,
    d."XCL_040" AS date_of_birth,
    r."XCL_069" AS race_name,
    lt."XCL_048" AS lap_time_ms
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN drivers AS d ON lt."XCL_044" = d."XCL_034"
JOIN races AS r ON lt."XCL_043" = r."XCL_065"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'Austrian'

        AND res."XCL_084" IS NOT NULL
  )
ORDER BY lt."XCL_048" ASC
LIMIT 1
